sources.quote: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *dušiti (“to suffocate, to choke”). Cognate with Belarusian душы́ць (dušýcʹ), Russian души́ть (dušítʹ), Czech dusit, Polish dusić, Bulgarian душа́ (dušá), Slovene dušiti.
